description: This file contains utility functions for extracting and processing Torch JIT IR graphs, creating tensors from types, running performance tests on Torch models, and managing JIT fusion strategies.

methods.name: extract_ir
methods.description: Extracts IR graphs from a file by parsing specific graph export markers.

methods.name: make_tensor_from_type
methods.description: Creates a tensor from a Torch TensorType object, ensuring all attributes are valid.

methods.name: load_graph_and_inputs
methods.description: Parses IR string into a Torch graph, creates inputs based on input types, and returns a function and inputs.

methods.name: time_cuda
methods.description: Measures execution time of a function on CUDA device.

methods.name: time_cpu
methods.description: Measures execution time of a function on CPU.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Runs a Torch graph with inputs, performs warmup, and measures execution time based on device type.

methods.name: no_fuser
methods.description: Context manager to disable JIT fusion optimization.

methods.name: run_baseline_no_fusion
methods.description: Runs a graph without fusion optimizations.

methods.name: run_nnc
methods.description: Runs a graph with NNC fusion strategy, either dynamic or static.

methods.name: run_nvfuser
methods.description: Runs a graph with NVFuser fusion strategy.
